entities.name: First Carib War
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: British attempts to survey and distribute Carib lands provoked the First Carib War (1769–1773). The Caribs, led by Chief Joseph Chatoyer, fought effectively and secured a treaty that recognized a Carib territory on the Windward side of the island.
